projectDescription: A tiny, performant animation library for the web built on the Web Animations API (WAAPI), providing DOM animations, scroll-linked animations, gestures, spring/glide easing, and timeline sequencing.
keyFeatures: Tiny bundle size with Web Animations API (WAAPI) at its core
animate() for animating DOM elements with CSS properties and transforms
timeline() for sequencing complex multi-element animations
scroll() for scroll-linked and scroll-triggered animations
inView() for intersection observer-based view animations
spring() and glide() physics-based easing generators
stagger() utility for staggered multi-element animations
Variant system for declarative state-driven animations
Gesture support: hover, press, and in-view states
Full AnimationControls API: play, pause, stop, finish, reverse, playbackRate
publicApiSurface: animate(elements, keyframes, options) — animate DOM elements or progress functions
timeline(definition, options) — sequence animations across multiple elements
inView(elements, onStart, options) — intersection observer animations
style.get(element, name) / style.set(element, name, value) — read/write styles
cubicBezier(x1, y1, x2, y2) — custom cubic bezier easing
createMotionState(options, parent) — low-level variant state machine
AnimationControls — play, pause, stop, finish, reverse, playbackRate, currentTime, duration, finished
